document_title: Compendium of Food Products Standards and Food Additives - Chapter 2.14 (Gluten free food)
category: Food Products Standards and Food Additives
text:
CHAPTER 2
FOOD PRODUCT STANDARDS
13[2.14 Gluten Free Food. - (1) Gluten free food consist of or is made of one or
more ingredients containing rice, millets, ragi, pulses or legumes.
 (2) It shall bear the label declaration referred to in sub-regulation 2.4.5 (50) of
Food Safety and Standards (Packaging and Labelling) Regulations, 2011.
73[(3) A food which, by its nature, is suitable for use as part of a gluten free diet
shall not be named as ‘special dietary’, ‘special dietetic’ or any other equivalent
term, however, such food may bear a statement on the label that ‘This food is
by its nature gluten free’:
Provided that it complies with the essential composition provisions for gluten
free food as set out in sub-regulation 2.14 (4) and such a statement does not
mislead the consumer.]
(4) For the purpose of labelling of a product as gluten free, when such a product
is analysed, the gluten levels shall be below 20 mg/kg as per the method declared
by the Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development or the
Association of Official Agricultural Chemists.
73[Omitted]
